title: Transfer (Deposit) Response
description: Result of the transfer. A real transfer returns `status` `complete`; a `dry_run` returns `dry_run_ok`.

status.description: `complete` when a real transfer was executed. `pending` when the transfer was accepted but is still being processed — use `GET /payment-agents/v1/transfer/{request_id}` with the supplied `request_id` to poll for the final status. `dry_run_ok` when `dry_run` was `true` and only validation was performed.

transaction_id.description: Identifier of the created transaction. `null` when `status` is `dry_run_ok` or `pending`.

client_real_name.description: Recipient's real name. Returned when the recipient shares it by setting `show_real_name` to `true`. `null` if they keep it private or it cannot be resolved.

client_is_agent.description: Whether the recipient is itself another payment agent. `true` for transfers between two payment agents, `false` for a transfer to a regular client.

metadata.description: Request metadata included in every response.

method.description: The HTTP method used for the request.

timing.description: Time in seconds for the service to process the request.
